summary: Iter-6 testing complete. Backend: 108/108 pytest cases PASS (19 new iter-6 tests added on top of 89 prior). Verified P0 entropy_veto regression fix: /api/signals/generate returns signal with populated noise_filter, regime, regime_execution_mode, meta_label, and compressed_features (mom_5d/mom_20d/vol_20d_annual). Regime-Adaptive Execution: LOW_VOL_TREND -> DEFENSIVE_SCALP with sl=0.85/tp=0.75, HIGH_VOL_TREND -> DYNAMIC_MOMENTUM with sl=1.40/tp=1.50, unknown regimes fall back to CAUTIOUS_WAIT. Meta-Labeler: HOLD -> NEUTRAL/p=0; BUY/SELL -> TRUE_SIGNAL or FAKE_OUT with p_true in [0,1]; FAKE_OUT cascades into veto_applied=true with 'VETO (meta-labeler)' in reasoning. Paper trading: account created with mode=paper/initial_balance=10000 (account_type=demo accepted; 'paper' is rejected by pydantic Literal — see code review), trade executed and persisted. NL Strategy Builder: 'Conservative gold trading during London' compiles into {risk_level=low, symbols=[XAUUSD], session_preference=london, notes=...} and apply persists via {compiled:{...}} envelope. NL Risk Commander: 'close all my open trades' returns receipts with CLOSE_ALL_TRADES; 'if Bitcoin drops 4% disable my high-risk bots' creates conditional_triggers row (symbol=BTCUSD, condition=drop, threshold_pct=4.0); DELETE /api/nl/triggers/{id} -> active=false. MongoDB Time-Series: price_ticks, signal_history, conditional_triggers collections all exist; price_ticks populated after GET /api/market/quote/BTCUSD with ts/symbol/price fields. Frontend: /commander loads, mode-command<->mode-strategy toggle works, risk-commander-input + risk-commander-send produce chat history, apply-strategy-button appears in STRATEGY mode after compile. Signals page verification-stack-BTCUSD renders three cards (EXEC MODE=DEFENSIVE_SCALP, NOISE·ENTROPY=CHOPPY·0.83, META-LABELER=NEUTRAL p=0). Sidebar nav-commander present and routes correctly.

minor.issue: AccountCreate.account_type Literal does not include 'paper' — clients passing account_type='paper' get 422. Workaround used: account_type='demo' + mode='paper'. Consider adding 'paper' to the Literal or aliasing it server-side.
5 PytestRemovedIn10Warning on class-scoped instance-method fixtures — pre-existing, not introduced this iter.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console shows intermittent 'WebSocket is closed before connection is established' warnings. Backend pytest TestWebSocket passes (token-auth works), so this looks like a reconnect-loop pattern client-side, not a server failure. Worth confirming the WS client uses the access_token cookie/query param consistently on retry.
Two 401 errors logged on first paint before login completes — likely from an eager fetch in a layout/provider. Cosmetic; doesn't block any user-facing flow.

issues: Legacy HOLD signals (those generated before iter-6) render the verification-stack cards with empty EXEC MODE / META-LABELER and just dashes — fine, but a subtle 'Legacy' badge or hiding the empty cards would improve clarity.

critical_code_review_comments: ai_signals.analyze_symbol now stacks five veto channels (news / regime / macro / entropy / meta-labeler) and writes each with a distinct 'VETO (...)' marker — easy to grep and good observability.

regime_adapter.adapt_profile_for_regime is pure (deepcopy) and uses multiplicative modifiers; min_conf_shift is additive, clamped via min(99, ...). REGIME_MODIFIERS hard-codes CHOP with min_confidence_delta=+99 — effectively unreachable threshold — good defensive default.

meta_labeler uses a hand-coded logistic regression over 8 explainable features (confidence_norm, sentiment_alignment, regime_quality, entropy_penalty, session_quality, rsi_extreme, macro_proximity, vol_extreme) — every output includes a 'features' dict for explainability. Threshold 0.55 is hard-coded; consider exposing per-profile if FAKE_OUT rate is too aggressive in extreme mode.
feature_compressor returns {available: False, reason: 'insufficient history'} for short histories instead of erroring — good defensive shape; UI should respect available flag (it does).

routes/nl_routes.py /strategy returns {compiled: {...}, prompt: ...} but /strategy/apply expects payload.compiled. Documented in tests; UI should pass {compiled} envelope (current /commander UI does).

Account schema (models.py L52) hard-codes Literal['microcent','cent','standard','demo'] for account_type. Paper-trading mode is signalled via 'mode' field (Literal['live','paper']) — this is the canonical way; review request slightly misled by saying account_type='paper'.

MongoDB time-series setup: seed.ensure_indexes creates price_ticks and signal_history as TS collections; market.get_quote inserts ticks every request — fine, but no TTL/retention configured. Long-running prod will need a retention policy.
No regression in file sizes; all backend modules remain <300 lines and well-separated.
